records.description: Napoli Centrale is the busy railway terminus at Piazza Garibaldi, and its passenger toilets have a listing on a cruising directory. The June 2026 comments are mainly people asking whether anyone wants to meet, not descriptions of an actual visit or encounter. The listing doesn't even specify which toilet block or floor is intended, so it would be misleading to pin a particular entrance. You can reach the station easily by rail or metro, but this is a supervised transport facility with staff, cleaning, CCTV and police presence, not a gay play venue. There is no evidence-backed best time, crowd description or current access arrangement for a specific cruising restroom. It should not be recommended as an active spot on the strength of online invitations alone.
records.opening_notes: Station and individual restroom hours controlled by railway operator; no verified cruising timetable.

records.description: Villa Comunale is Naples's long waterfront park along the Riviera di Chiaia, close to the Aquarium and the shoreline. Older gay guides refer to meeting among its shrubs or nearer the rocks, and one mentions mornings, but those claims predate extensive restoration work. The park was partly reopened in September 2026 after roughly two years of disruption, with further repairs still underway. That means the paths, gates and planting that made the old descriptions useful may have changed completely. The waterfront is shared by families, walkers and other visitors, and privacy was never reliable. Although more than one directory names this park, there is no confirmed firsthand cruising account since reopening. Until new visitor reports identify the accessible section and a genuine visiting period, this stays out of the live recommendations.
records.address: Villa Comunale, Riviera di Chiaia, Naples
records.opening_notes: Partially reopened September 2026; restoration works and temporary closures may continue.

records.description: Villa Gordiani is a sizeable archaeological park along Rome's Via Prenestina, with landscaped paths and surviving Roman structures. It appears in several independent gay cruising listings, so the location's reputation is better established than many entries in this project. However, the newer online material is mostly a 2026 editorial guide and a Squirt reply timestamp with no readable comment; neither establishes a recent encounter. A bigger practical problem is that Rome's visitor information describes the park as open from dawn until dusk, while older cruising directories recommend evenings or night. Don't treat a historic night-time suggestion as permission to enter after closing or cross archaeological fences. The exact current gathering area, best visiting period and crowd remain insufficiently verified.

Specific section within large park unclear
records.address: Villa dei Gordiani, Via Prenestina, Rome
records.opening_notes: Official visitor information: dawn to dusk; do not rely on nighttime directory claims.

records.description: Arkādijas Park is a leafy historic garden in Riga's Torņakalns district, near the railway and the streets Ojāra Vācieša and Friča Brīvzemnieka. Older directories refer to cruising around the paths and public toilets; one suggests evenings, while another says daytime, so there is no dependable peak period. A 2026 gay travel guide repeats its reputation, but the only recentish original user post, from August 2025, simply asks whether the place still works. Its garden paths are real and publicly accessible, but the specific restroom's opening and the claimed activity are not independently established today. Expect a regular urban park, not a guaranteed cruising crowd. Until a current firsthand visitor account confirms where men actually gather and when, this entry should be held.
blockers: No firsthand cruising report within twelve months
records.opening_notes: No verified current crowd or peak time; standard public park access.

records.description: This Warsaw listing points to a fee-paying public toilet around the junction of Widok and Krucza streets. An older directory describes cubicles and urinals as a cruising meeting place, but its specific claims about openings between stalls and prices should not be assumed to survive maintenance or changes in management. April 2026 comments suggest weekday hours around 11:30–19:00 and ask about paying the attendant, which helps establish contemporary online interest but not a recent encounter. The exact operator and current entrance have not been independently identified. This is a staffed public facility used by other people, so privacy, consent and the site's rules take priority. With no reliable crowd profile, verified visiting period or firsthand activity report, it remains unready for publication.
